Messages.Author: SCALAR NORSE
Messages.Body:
What happens when a meth who has the rack affecting a vamp has that vamp
stolen via grave robbing?

does does the vamp get 2 blood during the meth's turn who owns the rack?

does does the vamp get 2 blood during the meth's turn who owns vamp?

does the rack change control?

does the owner of the rack choose a new vamp to use it on?

does the rack just disapear?

Much appreaciated if a justifiable answer is forthcoming.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <3pseqn$6...@news.nevada.edu>, SCALAR NORSE <wa...@nevada.edu> wrote:
>What happens when a meth who has the rack affecting a vamp has that vamp
>stolen via grave robbing?
>
>
>does does the vamp get 2 blood during the meth's turn who owns the rack?

Yes.

>
>does does the vamp get 2 blood during the meth's turn who owns vamp?
>

No.

Note: The two above answers may be reversed if card text warrants it - I
don't beleive that it does, but haven't committed the card to memory yet :-)

>does the rack change control?

No.

>
>does the owner of the rack choose a new vamp to use it on?

Never. The Rack re-targets only when it changes controllers. (card text)

>
>does the rack just disapear?

Never. (Barring location-burners like Arson, Rampage, Unnatural Disaster).

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
SCALAR NORSE <wa...@nevada.edu> wrote:
>What happens when a meth who has the rack affecting a vamp has that vamp
>stolen via grave robbing?

The Rack says nothing about the vampire receiving the benefit changing
controllers, so the vampire would still get the benefit of the Rack until
the conditions described on the Rack were met.


